# Croian & Hein — the cellar, in full
Updated 2026-09-16. Prices on request. Delivery to Switzerland.
Contact: https://wa.me/5491141696601 · https://croianhein.com/

## Argentina

### Adrianna Vineyard, Mundus Bacillus Terrae
Origin: Gualtallary, Uco Valley · Grape: Malbec · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/adrianna-vineyard-mundus-bacillus-terrae/
A single block of the Adrianna Vineyard at 1,450 metres, on limestone, named for the soil bacteria that make it. Catena’s grand cru, and a perfect score in 2021.
- 2012: 9 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/adrianna-vineyard-mundus-bacillus-terrae/2012/
- 2013: 6 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/adrianna-vineyard-mundus-bacillus-terrae/2013/
- 2014: 6 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/adrianna-vineyard-mundus-bacillus-terrae/2014/
- 2016: 5 × bottles (100/100 points); 3 × magnums (100/100 points); 1 × double mag (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/adrianna-vineyard-mundus-bacillus-terrae/2016/
- 2021: 60 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/adrianna-vineyard-mundus-bacillus-terrae/2021/

### Bodega Chacra ‘32’
Origin: Mainqué, Río Negro, Patagonia · Grape: Pinot Noir · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-chacra-32/
Pinot Noir from vines planted in 1932, bought and revived by Piero Incisa della Rocchetta of the Sassicaia family. The 2018 was named Wine of the Year by James Suckling.
- 2016: 6 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-chacra-32/2016/
- 2018: 3 × bottles (J-M Roulot, 100/100 points); 3 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-chacra-32/2018/
- 2019: 3 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-chacra-32/2019/
- 2020: 3 × bottles; 6 × bottles (J-M Roulot). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-chacra-32/2020/
- 2021: 12 × bottles (J-M Roulot); 6 × bottles; 3 × magnums. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-chacra-32/2021/
- 2022: 6 × bottles (J-M Roulot); 3 × bottles (99/100 points); 60 × bottles; 6 × magnums; 1 × double mag. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-chacra-32/2022/
- 2023: 12 × bottles; 6 × bottles (98/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-chacra-32/2023/
- 2024: 12 × bottles; 3 × magnums. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-chacra-32/2024/

### Bodega La Rural, Felipe Rutini
Origin: Maipú, Mendoza · Grape: Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-la-rural-felipe-rutini/
Founded in 1885 by Felipe Rutini, La Rural is the oldest working winery in Mendoza. Its top cuvée from the 1980s and 1990s is almost impossible to find outside Argentina.
- 1982: 2 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-la-rural-felipe-rutini/1982/
- 1993: 2 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-la-rural-felipe-rutini/1993/
- 1997: 2 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-la-rural-felipe-rutini/1997/
- 1999: 6 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-la-rural-felipe-rutini/1999/

### Bodega López Montchenot
Origin: Maipú, Mendoza · Grape: Cabernet Sauvignon blend · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-lopez-montchenot/
Montchenot is the historic top wine of one of Mendoza’s oldest family bodegas, aged for years before release. Two magnums from 1975.
- 1974: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-lopez-montchenot/1974/
- 1975: 2 × magnums. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bodega-lopez-montchenot/1975/

### Catena Zapata Estiba Reservada
Origin: Agrelo, Mendoza · Grape: Cabernet Sauvignon · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/catena-zapata-estiba-reservada/
The first vintage was 1990, made from the oldest Cabernet at La Pirámide and released only when Nicolás Catena judged it ready. It is the wine that told the world Argentina could age.
- 1990: 4 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/catena-zapata-estiba-reservada/1990/
- 1991: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/catena-zapata-estiba-reservada/1991/

- 1999: 11 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/catena-zapata-estiba-reservada/1999/
- 2000: 12 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/catena-zapata-estiba-reservada/2000/

### Cobos Malbec Marchiori Estate
Origin: Perdriel, Luján de Cuyo · Grape: Malbec · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/cobos-malbec-marchiori-estate/
Paul Hobbs’ Argentine project, from old Malbec vines on the Marchiori family estate. The 2011 earned a perfect score, and the magnums came directly from the bodega.
- 2006: 7 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/cobos-malbec-marchiori-estate/2006/
- 2010: 6 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/cobos-malbec-marchiori-estate/2010/
- 2011: 4 × magnums (ex Bodega, 100/100 points); 3 × bottles (100/100 points); 1 × bottle (94/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/cobos-malbec-marchiori-estate/2011/
- 2013: 1 × bottle (93/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/cobos-malbec-marchiori-estate/2013/
- 2017: 6 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/cobos-malbec-marchiori-estate/2017/
- 2018: 6 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/cobos-malbec-marchiori-estate/2018/

### Uni del Bonnesant ‘312’, Perse
Origin: Gualtallary, Uco Valley · Grape: Malbec · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/uni-del-bonnesant-312-perse/
From a single high-altitude parcel in Gualtallary, made by David Bonomi and Edy del Pópolo. Tim Atkin named it Wine of the Year, twice.
- 2015: 2 × bottles (98/100 points); 4 × original cases (98/100 points); 6 × bottles (97/100 points); 6 × bottles; 39 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/uni-del-bonnesant-312-perse/2015/
- 2016: 1 × bottle (NV, 37.5cl); 4 × bottles; 1 × original case (99/100 points); 1 × original case (97/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/uni-del-bonnesant-312-perse/2016/
- 2017: 6 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/uni-del-bonnesant-312-perse/2017/
- 2018: 3 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/uni-del-bonnesant-312-perse/2018/
- 2019: 5 × bottles (100/100 points); 6 × bottles (100/100 points); 6 × bottles (99/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/uni-del-bonnesant-312-perse/2019/
- 2021: 6 × bottles (100/100 points); 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/uni-del-bonnesant-312-perse/2021/

### Weinert Malbec Estrella
Origin: Luján de Cuyo, Mendoza · Grape: Malbec · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/weinert-malbec-estrella/
Cavas de Weinert age their wines in old French oak for years before release, and Estrella is made only in exceptional vintages. This is the first edition, from 1977.
- 1977: 6 × bottles (Cavas, 1er edicion). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/weinert-malbec-estrella/1977/
- 1978: 1 × bottle (Cavas). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/weinert-malbec-estrella/1978/
- 1985: 6 × bottles (Cavas). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/weinert-malbec-estrella/1985/

## Bordeaux

### Château Haut-Brion
Origin: Pessac-Léognan, Graves · Grape: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-haut-brion/
The oldest of the first growths, already famous in London in the 1660s. The 1959 is a legendary vintage that has earned a perfect score, and at over sixty years it still carries the estate’s signature of warm bricks and tobacco.
- 1959: 1 × bottle (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-haut-brion/1959/
- 1974: 1 × bottle (lovely!). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-haut-brion/1974/
- 1992: 3 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-haut-brion/1992/
- 1993: 3 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-haut-brion/1993/
- 1994: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-haut-brion/1994/

### Château Latour
Origin: Pauillac, Médoc · Grape: Cabernet Sauvignon blend · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-latour/
The 1961 vintage is the yardstick every other Bordeaux year is measured against, and Latour made the wine of the vintage. This bottle comes from the Berry Bros. & Rudd Family Reserves, one of the finest private cellars in London.
- 1961: 1 × bottle (top-shoulder fill, 100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-latour/1961/
- 1993: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-latour/1993/
- 1994: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-latour/1994/
- 2009: 3 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-latour/2009/
- 2012: 6 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-latour/2012/
- 2016: 6 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-latour/2016/
- 2019: 6 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-latour/2019/

### Château Mouton Rothschild
Origin: Pauillac, Médoc · Grape: Cabernet Sauvignon blend · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-mouton-rothschild/
Every vintage since 1945 carries a label by a different artist. The 1993 drawing by Balthus was refused in the United States, so American bottles shipped with a blank label. These carry the drawing.
- 1973: 1 × bottle (good level and label). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-mouton-rothschild/1973/
- 1974: 2 × bottles (perfect levels and labels). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-mouton-rothschild/1974/
- 1982: 3 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-mouton-rothschild/1982/
- 1993: 5 × bottles (good levels and lovely Balthus labels). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-mouton-rothschild/1993/
- 2019: 3 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-mouton-rothschild/2019/
- 2023: 6 × bottles (99/100 points); 3 × magnums (99/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-mouton-rothschild/2023/

### Le Pin
Origin: Pomerol · Grape: Merlot · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/le-pin/
A garden of barely two hectares bought by the Thienpont family in 1979, fermented in a cellar under a modest house. Production rarely passes a few hundred cases, which is why Le Pin became the first cult wine of Bordeaux.
- 1982: 1 × bottle (neck level & dusty label). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/le-pin/1982/
- 1984: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/le-pin/1984/
- 1987: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/le-pin/1987/
- 1991: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/le-pin/1991/
- 1992: 5 × half bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/le-pin/1992/

### Liber Pater
Origin: Landiras, Graves · Grape: Old Bordeaux varieties, ungrafted · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/liber-pater/
Loïc Pasquet replanted forgotten pre-phylloxera varieties on their own roots, at the densities of the 19th century. A few hundred bottles a year, and by some distance the most expensive young wine in Bordeaux.
- 2010: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/liber-pater/2010/

### Pétrus
Origin: Pomerol, right bank of the Dordogne · Grape: Merlot · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/
Eleven hectares of blue clay on the Pomerol plateau, farmed by the Moueix family and made almost entirely from Merlot. Pétrus never had a château to speak of; it had the soil, and the soil made it the most sought-after wine in Bordeaux.
- 1946: 1 × bottle (very top-shoulder fill). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/1946/
- 1954: 1 × bottle (very top-shoulder fill). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/1954/
- 1969: 1 × bottle (neck level). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/1969/
- 1971: 1 × bottle (u/s & slightly torn capsule). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/1971/
- 1973: 1 × bottle (top-shoulder fill). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/1973/
- 1974: 1 × bottle (upper-shoulder fill). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/1974/
- 1976: 1 × bottle (neck level & pretty label). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/1976/
- 1982: 2 × bottles (super levels). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/1982/
- 1986: 1 × bottle (neck level). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/1986/
- 1995: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/1995/
- 2003: 1 × bottle (original wooden case). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/2003/
- 2012: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/2012/
- 2013: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/2013/
- 2017: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/2017/
- 2020: 3 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/2020/
- 2024: 1 × bottle (original wooden case). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/petrus/2024/

## Burgundy

### Bourgogne Blanc, Domaine Leroy
Origin: Côte de Beaune · Grape: Chardonnay · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bourgogne-blanc-domaine-leroy/
The regional white from the same hands as the Musigny, farmed biodynamically to yields that would make most growers weep. The 2016 was a tiny, frost-struck crop.
- 2016: 120 × bottles; 6 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bourgogne-blanc-domaine-leroy/2016/
- 2017: 6 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bourgogne-blanc-domaine-leroy/2017/

### Chablis Les Clos, Vincent Dauvissat
Origin: Chablis, grand cru · Grape: Chardonnay · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chablis-les-clos-vincent-dauvissat/
The greatest of the Chablis grands crus, from a grower who still ploughs by horse in places and bottles with a minimum of intervention. Les Clos is stony, saline and long-lived.
- 2018: 1 × bottle (Glorious!). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chablis-les-clos-vincent-dauvissat/2018/

### Clos de la Roche, Jacky Truchot
Origin: Morey-Saint-Denis, Côte de Nuits · Grape: Pinot Noir · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/clos-de-la-roche-jacky-truchot/
Jacky Truchot retired in 2005 and sold his vines, and his pale, whole-cluster wines went from local secret to obsession. The grand cru Clos de la Roche was his largest holding, which still meant only a few barrels.
- 1987: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/clos-de-la-roche-jacky-truchot/1987/
- 2001: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/clos-de-la-roche-jacky-truchot/2001/
- 2003: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/clos-de-la-roche-jacky-truchot/2003/
- 2005: 1 × bottle (100pts WPH). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/clos-de-la-roche-jacky-truchot/2005/

### La Tâche
Origin: Vosne-Romanée, Côte de Nuits · Grape: Pinot Noir · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/la-tache/
Six hectares, one owner, and a wine that is often the most exotic in the domaine’s range: spice, rose and iron. Older bottles were labelled with the level at the neck, as the 1992 is here.
- 1992: 1 × bottle (2.5cms). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/la-tache/1992/
- 2021: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/la-tache/2021/

### Musigny, Domaine Leroy
Origin: Chambolle-Musigny, Côte de Nuits · Grape: Pinot Noir · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/musigny-domaine-leroy/
Lalou Bize-Leroy farms 0.27 hectares of Musigny biodynamically and bottles a few hundred bottles in a good year. It has become the most expensive wine in the world at auction, and almost never leaves the cellars it enters.
- 2011: 3 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/musigny-domaine-leroy/2011/

### Romanée-Conti
Origin: Vosne-Romanée, Côte de Nuits · Grape: Pinot Noir · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/
A monopole of 1.8 hectares that yields around five thousand bottles a year, sold only as part of a mixed case. Nothing in Burgundy is more difficult to obtain, or more quietly resold.
- 1974: 1 × bottle (1.5cms). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/1974/
- 1975: 1 × bottle (1.5cms). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/1975/
- 1976: 1 × bottle (1.00cm). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/1976/
- 1996: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/1996/
- 2002: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/2002/
- 2005: 1 × bottle (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/2005/
- 2012: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/2012/
- 2014: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/2014/
- 2017: 2 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/2017/
- 2019: 1 × bottle (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/2019/
- 2020: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/2020/
- 2021: 1 × bottle (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/2021/
- 2022: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/romanee-conti/2022/

### Vosne-Romanée, Henri Jayer
Origin: Vosne-Romanée, Côte de Nuits · Grape: Pinot Noir · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vosne-romanee-henri-jayer/
Henri Jayer made wine from 1951 until 2001 and taught a generation of Burgundy to destem and to wait. His village Vosne-Romanée is the humblest bottle he signed, and one of the rarest things a collector can open.
- 1992: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vosne-romanee-henri-jayer/1992/

## California

### Screaming Eagle
Origin: Oakville, Napa Valley · Grape: Cabernet Sauvignon · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/screaming-eagle/
Around five hundred cases a year, sold only through a mailing list with a decade-long wait. The 2019 earned a perfect score.
- 2019: 3 × bottles (100/100 points); 1 × bottle (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/screaming-eagle/2019/

## Champagne

### Bollinger Vieilles Vignes Françaises
Origin: Aÿ and Bouzy · Grape: Pinot Noir · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bollinger-vieilles-vignes-francaises/
Blanc de noirs from two tiny plots of ungrafted vines that survived phylloxera, worked by hand and by hoe. Around three thousand bottles in a good year.
- 2016: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/bollinger-vieilles-vignes-francaises/2016/

### Dom Pérignon
Origin: Épernay · Grape: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/dom-perignon/
The 1960s vintages of Dom Pérignon were made in tiny quantities compared with today and have aged into something closer to old white Burgundy. The 1985 Rosé is one of the house’s rarest bottlings.
- 1962: 2 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/dom-perignon/1962/
- 1964: 2 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/dom-perignon/1964/
- 1966: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/dom-perignon/1966/
- 1969: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/dom-perignon/1969/
- 1976: 3 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/dom-perignon/1976/
- 1978: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/dom-perignon/1978/
- 1983: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/dom-perignon/1983/
- 1985: 6 × bottles; 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/dom-perignon/1985/
- 2017: 12 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/dom-perignon/2017/

### Jacques Selosse
Origin: Avize, Côte des Blancs · Grape: Chardonnay, Pinot Noir · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/jacques-selosse/
Anselme Selosse brought Burgundian thinking to Champagne: oak, oxidative ageing and a solera for the reserve wines. Initial is the entry point, the Rosé is one of the hardest bottles in the region to find.
- 2013: 3 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/jacques-selosse/2013/
- NV: 2 × bottles (Disg.Mai 2021); 3 × bottles (Disg.16/01/2020); 6 × bottles (Disg.14/06/2020); 3 × bottles (94/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/jacques-selosse/nv/

### Louis Roederer Cristal
Origin: Reims · Grape: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/louis-roederer-cristal/
Created in 1876 for Tsar Alexander II, who wanted a clear bottle with a flat bottom so nothing could be hidden inside it. The 1964 and 1966 are among the finest old Champagnes still drinking.
- 1964: 4 × bottles (1cm). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/louis-roederer-cristal/1964/
- 1966: 1 × bottle (perfect). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/louis-roederer-cristal/1966/
- 2004: 60 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/louis-roederer-cristal/2004/
- 2012: 3 × bottles (Gift Boxes). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/louis-roederer-cristal/2012/
- 2013: 6 × magnums. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/louis-roederer-cristal/2013/

### Louis Roederer Rosé
Origin: Reims · Grape: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/louis-roederer-rose/
The first rosé vintage the house ever released. One bottle, more than half a century old, from a cellar that kept it in the dark.
- 1974: 1 × bottle (Super Rare! The first vintage ever produced***). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/louis-roederer-rose/1974/

### Salon ‘S’ Le Mesnil
Origin: Le Mesnil-sur-Oger, Côte des Blancs · Grape: Chardonnay · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/salon-s-le-mesnil/
One village, one grape, one vintage, and only in years the house considers worthy: fewer than forty releases since 1905. Salon is released after a decade on its lees and rewards another.
- 1999: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/salon-s-le-mesnil/1999/

## Germany

### Egon Müller Scharzhofberger Auslese
Origin: Wiltingen, Saar · Grape: Riesling · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/egon-muller-scharzhofberger-auslese/
The Auslese is the wine Egon Müller is most often judged by: gold, weightless and capable of fifty years. From the same steep slate slope as the TBA.
- 2011: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/egon-muller-scharzhofberger-auslese/2011/
- 2012: 1 × half bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/egon-muller-scharzhofberger-auslese/2012/

### Egon Müller Scharzhofberger TBA
Origin: Wiltingen, Saar · Grape: Riesling · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/egon-muller-scharzhofberger-tba/
Trockenbeerenauslese from the Scharzhofberg, picked berry by berry from shrivelled botrytised grapes, and made in a few hundred half bottles only in extraordinary years. The most expensive sweet wine in the world.
- 2010: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/egon-muller-scharzhofberger-tba/2010/
- 2018: 1 × half bottle (100/100 points); 1 × bottle (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/egon-muller-scharzhofberger-tba/2018/

### Schloss Johannisberg Ex Bibliotheca Cuvée 100
Origin: Johannisberg, Rheingau · Grape: Riesling · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/schloss-johannisberg-ex-bibliotheca-cuvee-100/
From the estate’s Bibliotheca, the cellar library where a few bottles of every vintage since 1748 are kept. A thousand bottles were filled of this Spätlese cuvée.
- NV: 2 × bottles (Only 1.000bts filled*). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/schloss-johannisberg-ex-bibliotheca-cuvee-100/nv/

## Hungary

### Tokaji Essencia, Royal Tokaji
Origin: Tokaj-Hegyalja · Grape: Furmint · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/tokaji-essencia-royal-tokaji/
The free-run juice of botrytised aszú berries, so rich in sugar that it takes years to ferment to a few degrees of alcohol. Served by the spoon, and reputed to raise the dying.
- 1964: 3 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/tokaji-essencia-royal-tokaji/1964/
- 2007: 1 × half bottle (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/tokaji-essencia-royal-tokaji/2007/

### Masseto
Origin: Bolgheri, Tuscan coast · Grape: Merlot · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/masseto/
Seven hectares of blue clay on a hill above Ornellaia, planted to Merlot in 1984 almost by accident. It became Italy’s answer to Pétrus, and the only Italian wine traded like a first growth.

### Montepulciano d’Abruzzo, Emidio Pepe
Origin: Torano Nuovo, Abruzzo · Grape: Montepulciano · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/montepulciano-dabruzzo-emidio-pepe/
Grapes crushed by foot, wines aged in glass-lined cement and decanted by hand, bottle by bottle, before release. Emidio Pepe’s 1970s wines are among the greatest old Italian reds in existence.
- 1974: 2 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/montepulciano-dabruzzo-emidio-pepe/1974/

The first vintage commercially released, made by Lodovico Antinori on the estate his family had used for hunting. Four bottles from the year the Bolgheri legend began.

### Ribolla Gialla, Gravner & Radikon
Origin: Oslavia, Friuli · Grape: Ribolla Gialla · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/ribolla-gialla-gravner-and-radikon/
Two neighbours who reinvented white wine by fermenting it on the skins, Gravner in buried Georgian amphorae. Amber, tannic, and unlike anything else in the world.

## Lebanon

### Château Musar
Origin: Bekaa Valley · Grape: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cinsault, Carignan · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-musar/
Serge Hochar made wine through the civil war, trucking grapes across front lines, and released each vintage seven years later. The 1970s Musars are among the great old reds of the Mediterranean.

## Madeira

### D’Oliveiras Madeira Sercial
Origin: Funchal, Madeira · Grape: Sercial · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/doliveiras-madeira-sercial/
Madeira is the only wine that improves for two centuries and survives an open bottle for a year. D’Oliveiras keeps its oldest casks in Funchal and bottles on demand.
- 1937: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/doliveiras-madeira-sercial/1937/
- 1939: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/doliveiras-madeira-sercial/1939/

## Portugal

### Quinta do Noval Nacional
Origin: Pinhão, Douro Valley · Grape: Traditional Douro varieties, ungrafted · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/quinta-do-noval-nacional/
Two and a half hectares of ungrafted vines in the middle of the Noval estate, which survived phylloxera and still produce a few hundred cases in declared years. The most mythical name in Port.
- 2000: 4 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/quinta-do-noval-nacional/2000/
- 2004: 5 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/quinta-do-noval-nacional/2004/

### Warre Vintage Port
Origin: Douro Valley · Grape: Touriga Nacional and traditional varieties · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/warre-vintage-port/
The oldest British Port house, founded in 1670. The 1947 is one of the great post-war declarations and is now at its peak.
- 1947: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/warre-vintage-port/1947/

## Rhône

### Château Rayas
Origin: Châteauneuf-du-Pape · Grape: Grenache · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-rayas/
Pale, perfumed Grenache from cool sandy soils under pine trees, the opposite of what the appellation is supposed to taste like. Emmanuel Reynaud makes it as his uncle did, and the world waits.

A few hundred cases of white from the same sandy vineyards, waxy and honeyed with age. Harder to find than the red, and adored by the sommeliers who know it.

Henri Bonneau made wine in a damp cellar under the village, in old barrels he refused to replace, and released it when he felt like it. The Célestins is Grenache from the pebbles of La Crau at its most profound.

### Ermitage Cuvée Cathelin, J-L Chave

Made only in years Jean-Louis Chave judges exceptional, from the best barrels of the hill, and named after the painter Bernard Cathelin. Around two hundred cases each time, and every vintage offered here scores a perfect hundred.

### Hermitage La Chapelle, Jaboulet
Origin: Hermitage, northern Rhône · Grape: Syrah · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/hermitage-la-chapelle-jaboulet/
Named for the small chapel on top of the hill of Hermitage. The 1978 is the most famous wine Jaboulet ever made, and one of a handful of Rhônes to earn a perfect score from Robert Parker.

### Rivesaltes, Château Mossé
Origin: Rivesaltes, Pyrénées-Orientales · Grape: Grenache · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/rivesaltes-chateau-mosse/
Fortified Grenache aged for decades in cask and demijohn under the Roussillon sun. The 1931 has the colour of old mahogany and tastes of walnuts and orange peel.
- 1931: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/rivesaltes-chateau-mosse/1931/
- 1949: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/rivesaltes-chateau-mosse/1949/
- 1955: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/rivesaltes-chateau-mosse/1955/
- 1966: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/rivesaltes-chateau-mosse/1966/
- 1975: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/rivesaltes-chateau-mosse/1975/
- 1984: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/rivesaltes-chateau-mosse/1984/

## Sauternes

### Château d’Yquem
Origin: Sauternes, left bank · Grape: Sémillon, Sauvignon Blanc · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/
The only premier cru supérieur of the 1855 classification, made from botrytised grapes picked berry by berry. Yquem lives for a century or more; the 1894 was bottled when the château still belonged to the Lur-Saluces family.
- 1894: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/1894/
- 1916: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/1916/
- 1946: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/1946/
- 1947: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/1947/
- 1962: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/1962/
- 1973: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/1973/
- 1983: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/1983/
- 1986: 2 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/1986/
- 1996: 2 × bottles; 1 × original case (ex Chateau stock). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/1996/
- 2004: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/2004/
- 2005: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/2005/
- 2006: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/2006/
- 2007: 4 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/2007/
- 2008: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/2008/
- 2009: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/2009/
- 2010: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/2010/
- 2023: 12 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem/2023/

### Château d’Yquem, halves
Origin: Sauternes, left bank · Grape: Sémillon, Sauvignon Blanc · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem-halves/
The half bottle is the format Yquem was meant for at table: one glass each for six, with the last of the cheese. The 1990 is one of the estate’s three perfect vintages of the decade.
- 1990: 2 × half bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem-halves/1990/
- 2023: 6 × half bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/chateau-dyquem-halves/2023/

## Sicily

### Marsala Riserva ‘Bronte’, Woodhouse & Co.
Origin: Marsala, western Sicily · Grape: Grillo, Catarratto · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/marsala-riserva-bronte-woodhouse-and-co/
John Woodhouse, an English merchant, created the Marsala trade in 1773 and supplied Nelson’s fleet. This reserve was laid down in the year of Waterloo, in the barrels named for the Duchy of Bronte given to Nelson. The oldest liquid on the list.
- 1815: 1 × bottle (ex 'Waterloo' barrel reserve). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/marsala-riserva-bronte-woodhouse-and-co/1815/
- 1834: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/marsala-riserva-bronte-woodhouse-and-co/1834/

## Spain

### Comando G, Rumbo al Norte
Origin: Sierra de Gredos, Ávila · Grape: Garnacha · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/
Half a hectare of old Garnacha on granite at 1,200 metres, farmed by two friends who made Gredos famous. Pale, perfumed and Burgundian; most vintages score a perfect hundred.
- 2010: 3 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/2010/
- 2012: 4 × bottles; 2 × magnums. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/2012/
- 2013: 4 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/2013/
- 2015: 5 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/2015/
- 2016: 4 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/2016/
- 2017: 1 × bottle; 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/2017/
- 2018: 2 × bottles; 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/2018/
- 2019: 12 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/2019/
- 2020: 1 × bottle; 6 × bottles; 7 × bottles; 1 × magnum. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/2020/
- 2021: 22 × bottles; 12 × bottles (100/100 points); 1 × bottle (100/100 points); 2 × bottles (Albillo, 99/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/2021/
- 2022: 1 × magnum (the last vintage to be produced*); 2 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/2022/
- 2023: 1 × bottle (label slightly stained); 3 × bottles (labels slightly stained); 2 × bottles (labels slightly stained). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/comando-g-rumbo-al-norte/2023/

### La Faraona, Descendientes de J. Palacios
Origin: Corullón, Bierzo · Grape: Mencía · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/la-faraona-descendientes-de-j-palacios/
A single terrace of half a hectare on quartz and slate, worked by mule by Ricardo Pérez Palacios. Around six hundred bottles a year and, in 2014, a perfect score.
- 2003: 2 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/la-faraona-descendientes-de-j-palacios/2003/
- 2013: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/la-faraona-descendientes-de-j-palacios/2013/
- 2014: 3 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/la-faraona-descendientes-de-j-palacios/2014/
- 2015: 2 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/la-faraona-descendientes-de-j-palacios/2015/
- 2017: 3 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/la-faraona-descendientes-de-j-palacios/2017/
- 2018: 12 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/la-faraona-descendientes-de-j-palacios/2018/
- 2019: 12 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/la-faraona-descendientes-de-j-palacios/2019/
- 2020: 3 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/la-faraona-descendientes-de-j-palacios/2020/

### Las Beatas, Telmo Rodríguez
Origin: Rioja Alta · Grape: Tempranillo, Garnacha, Graciano · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/las-beatas-telmo-rodriguez/
Two hectares of abandoned terraces recovered stone by stone by Telmo Rodríguez, the man who rebuilt the reputation of old Spain. Both vintages here earned a perfect score.
- 2014: 6 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/las-beatas-telmo-rodriguez/2014/
- 2015: 6 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/las-beatas-telmo-rodriguez/2015/
- 2016: 5 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/las-beatas-telmo-rodriguez/2016/
- 2017: 6 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/las-beatas-telmo-rodriguez/2017/

### Pingus
Origin: La Horra, Ribera del Duero · Grape: Tempranillo · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/pingus/
Peter Sisseck’s four hectares of very old vines, farmed biodynamically. A few hundred cases a year and, since the first vintage in 1995, Spain’s most sought-after modern wine.
- 2018: 3 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/pingus/2018/

### Vega Sicilia Único
Origin: Valbuena de Duero, Ribera del Duero · Grape: Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vega-sicilia-unico/
Spain’s first great wine, released only after ten years in cask and bottle. The 1962 and 1968 are perfect-score vintages; the 1965 is described in the cellar book with one word: immaculate.
- 1962: 1 × bottle (100/100 points); 1 × magnum (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vega-sicilia-unico/1962/
- 1965: 2 × bottles (immaculate!). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vega-sicilia-unico/1965/
- 1968: 3 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vega-sicilia-unico/1968/
- 1973: 1 × bottle (very top-shoulder fill). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vega-sicilia-unico/1973/
- 1976: 1 × bottle (immaculate!). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vega-sicilia-unico/1976/

### Viña Tondonia, López de Heredia
Origin: Haro, Rioja Alta · Grape: Tempranillo, Garnacha, Viura · Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vina-tondonia-lopez-de-heredia/
A bodega that has changed almost nothing since 1877: American oak, long ageing, cobwebs. The 1973 red and the 1976 white Reserva are what old Rioja is supposed to taste like.
- 1973: 3 × bottles (Cosecha Tinto de 1973). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vina-tondonia-lopez-de-heredia/1973/
- 1976: 2 × bottles. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vina-tondonia-lopez-de-heredia/1976/
- 2004: 4 × magnums; 2 × bottles (100/100 points). Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vina-tondonia-lopez-de-heredia/2004/
- 2006: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vina-tondonia-lopez-de-heredia/2006/
- 2013: 1 × bottle. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vina-tondonia-lopez-de-heredia/2013/
- 2014: 12 × magnums. Page: https://croianhein.com/cellar/vina-tondonia-lopez-de-heredia/2014/
